propositions: Documentation policy must define eight distinct roles (tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, protected evidence) with audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citations, correction method, and examples for each.

Writing rules and Protected forms guidance must be restored as approved authoring guidance without creating a deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validator or repository gate.
Generated artifact and parity-gated catalog tables must be relocated to docs/generated-artifacts.md with pre-F01 descriptions preserved and all inventory consumers repointed.
Policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md must describe the policy as ownership and writing guidance without labeling it as a deterministic enforcement gate.
Ticket corrections must remain append-only events and ADR decision substance must be preserved through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs.
No new hook, test gate, CI gate, or runtime rejection based on writing guidance; no edits to generated outputs, ADR substance, ticket events, or historical evidence.
